root_cause.text: Race condition in xfrm iptfs __input_process_payload: after storing first_skb into xtfs->ra_newskb under drop_lock and unlocking, the code reads xtfs->ra_newskb without the lock to check ownership, allowing a concurrent CPU to complete reassembly, NULL ra_newskb, and free the skb, leading to use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: Commit message states: "Between spin_unlock and this read, a concurrent CPU running iptfs_reassem_cont() (or the drop_timer hrtimer) can complete reassembly, NULL xtfs->ra_newskb, and free the skb." The patch replaces the unlocked read (first_skb != xtfs->ra_newskb) with a local boolean flag set before the break.
